environment.description: EC2 instance (m5.large, Amazon Linux 2) running the order service monolith directly on port 8080. Instance is in a VPC subnet with security group allowing inbound TCP/8080 from 10.0.0.0/16. No service mesh sidecar. The application is deployed as a systemd service with Restart=always. Other microservices in the VPC (in different logical tiers) can reach this port directly. No Kubernetes, no Istio, no envoy proxy in the request path.
